mgmt_bio.text: Yuen Kuan Moon has been Group Chief Executive Officer of Singapore Telecommunications Limited (Singtel) since 1 January 2021; he joined the company in 1993 after graduating from the University of Western Australia with first-class honours in engineering, and also holds a Master of Science in Management from Stanford University. He has held leadership roles in marketing, business development and sales, including vice president of regional operations, and was posted to Telkomsel in 2003 as general manager for product development before serving as director of commerce from 2005 to 2007. Before becoming Group CEO he was CEO, Consumer Singapore from June 2012 and drove the group's digital transformation as Group Chief Digital Officer from August 2018 to December 2020. His appointment, succeeding Chua Sock Koong, followed a global search considering internal and external candidates.
